description: Land Title Settle Department - Walpita, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510004
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and addresses, title classifications, and any encumbrances or special conditions. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and property rights, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
